_comment: Federal forms for the IRS Forms library. Links point at irs.gov only - nothing is re-hosted. latest_revision and last_verified are written by `python -m scripts.verify_forms --update`, which reads each PDF from irs.gov. one_liner_reviewed stays false until a person has checked the description against the form's instructions; the UI labels unreviewed descriptions.

forms.title: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: The main annual income tax return for U.S. individuals.

forms.title: U.S. Tax Return for Seniors
forms.one_liner: An alternative to Form 1040 with larger print for taxpayers age 65 or older.

forms.title: U.S. Nonresident Alien Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: The income tax return for nonresident aliens with U.S.-source income.

forms.title: Additional Income and Adjustments to Income
forms.one_liner: Reports income not on Form 1040 itself (business, rental, unemployment) and adjustments such as educator expenses or HSA deductions.

forms.title: Additional Taxes
forms.one_liner: Reports extra taxes such as alternative minimum tax, self-employment tax and additional tax on retirement accounts.

forms.title: Additional Credits and Payments
forms.one_liner: Reports nonrefundable credits (foreign tax, child care, education) and other payments not on Form 1040.

forms.title: Itemized Deductions
forms.one_liner: Lists itemized deductions such as medical expenses, state and local taxes, mortgage interest and charitable gifts.

forms.title: Interest and Ordinary Dividends
forms.one_liner: Lists interest and dividend income above the reporting threshold and asks about foreign accounts and trusts.

forms.title: Profit or Loss From Business
forms.one_liner: Reports income and expenses of a sole proprietorship or single-member LLC taxed as one.

forms.title: Capital Gains and Losses
forms.one_liner: Summarizes capital gains and losses from sales of stock, property and other capital assets.

forms.title: Supplemental Income and Loss
forms.one_liner: Reports rental real estate, royalties and income from partnerships, S corporations, estates and trusts.

forms.title: Profit or Loss From Farming
forms.one_liner: Reports farm income and expenses for an individual farmer.

forms.title: Household Employment Taxes
forms.one_liner: Reports Social Security, Medicare and unemployment taxes owed for household employees such as nannies.

forms.title: Self-Employment Tax
forms.one_liner: Computes Social Security and Medicare tax on net earnings from self-employment.

forms.title: Credits for Qualifying Children and Other Dependents
forms.one_liner: Computes the child tax credit, the additional child tax credit and the credit for other dependents.

forms.title: Estimated Tax for Individuals
forms.one_liner: Worksheet and payment vouchers for paying quarterly estimated income tax.

forms.title: Payment Voucher
forms.one_liner: Voucher sent with a check or money order for a balance due on Form 1040.

forms.title: Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Individuals, Estates, and Trusts
forms.one_liner: Figures whether a penalty applies for paying too little estimated tax during the year, and how much.

forms.title: Child and Dependent Care Expenses
forms.one_liner: Claims the credit for care costs paid so the taxpayer (and spouse) could work or look for work.

forms.title: Education Credits (American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning Credits)
forms.one_liner: Claims the American Opportunity and Lifetime Learning credits for qualified tuition and related expenses.

forms.title: Sales and Other Dispositions of Capital Assets
forms.one_liner: Lists each sale of a capital asset with dates, proceeds and basis; totals carry to Schedule D.

forms.title: Expenses for Business Use of Your Home
forms.one_liner: Figures the deductible home office expenses of a sole proprietor filing Schedule C.

forms.title: Premium Tax Credit (PTC)
forms.one_liner: Reconciles advance premium tax credit payments for Marketplace health insurance with the credit actually allowed.

forms.title: Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
forms.one_liner: Reports HSA contributions, the deduction and distributions.

forms.title: Nondeductible IRAs
forms.one_liner: Tracks basis in traditional IRAs and reports Roth conversions and Roth IRA distributions.

forms.title: Additional Taxes on Qualified Plans (Including IRAs) and Other Tax-Favored Accounts
forms.one_liner: Reports extra taxes on early distributions, excess contributions and missed required minimum distributions.

forms.title: Alternative Minimum Tax—Individuals
forms.one_liner: Figures whether the individual owes alternative minimum tax.

forms.title: Qualified Business Income Deduction Simplified Computation
forms.one_liner: Figures the qualified business income (Section 199A) deduction for taxpayers below the income threshold.

forms.title: Qualified Business Income Deduction
forms.one_liner: Figures the Section 199A deduction when income is above the threshold or limitations apply.

forms.title: Foreign Tax Credit (Individual, Estate, or Trust)
forms.one_liner: Claims a credit for income taxes paid to a foreign country.

forms.title: Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets
forms.one_liner: Reports foreign financial assets above the filing threshold (FATCA).

forms.title: Additional Medicare Tax
forms.one_liner: Figures the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on wages and self-employment income above the threshold.

forms.title: Net Investment Income Tax—Individuals, Estates, and Trusts
forms.one_liner: Figures the 3.8% net investment income tax.

forms.title: Noncash Charitable Contributions
forms.one_liner: Reports donated property (not cash) when the total deduction is over $500, with appraisal details for larger gifts.

forms.title: Statement of Person Claiming Refund Due a Deceased Taxpayer
forms.one_liner: Lets a survivor or representative claim a refund owed to a taxpayer who has died.

forms.title: Injured Spouse Allocation
forms.one_liner: Lets a spouse recover their share of a joint refund that was applied to the other spouse's past-due debt.

forms.title: Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Requests an automatic six-month extension to file Form 1040; it does not extend the time to pay.

forms.title: Amended U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Corrects a Form 1040 that was already filed.

forms.title: Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File Certain Business Income Tax, Information, and Other Returns
forms.one_liner: Requests an automatic extension to file business returns such as Forms 1120, 1120-S, 1065 and 1041.

forms.title: Amended U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Corrects a Form 1120 that was already filed or claims a refund.

forms.title: Application for Extension of Time To File an Exempt Organization Return or Excise Taxes Related to Employee Benefit Plans
forms.one_liner: Requests an automatic extension to file Form 990-series returns.

forms.title: U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: The annual income tax return for C corporations.

forms.title: U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation
forms.one_liner: The annual return for S corporations, reporting income that passes through to shareholders.

forms.title: U.S. Return of Partnership Income
forms.one_liner: The annual information return for partnerships and multi-member LLCs taxed as partnerships.

forms.title: Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.
forms.one_liner: Reports each partner's share of partnership income, deductions and credits.

forms.title: Shareholder's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.
forms.one_liner: Reports each shareholder's share of S corporation income, deductions and credits.

forms.title: Beneficiary's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.
forms.one_liner: Reports each beneficiary's share of an estate's or trust's income, deductions and credits.

forms.title: Partners' Distributive Share Items—International
forms.one_liner: Reports partnership items of international tax relevance on the partnership return.

forms.title: Partner's Share of Income, Deductions, Credits, etc.—International
forms.one_liner: Gives each partner their share of the international items reported on Schedule K-2.

forms.title: Cost of Goods Sold
forms.one_liner: Figures cost of goods sold for corporations and partnerships.

forms.title: Depreciation and Amortization
forms.one_liner: Reports depreciation, Section 179 expensing and amortization of business assets, and listed-property details.

forms.title: Sales of Business Property
forms.one_liner: Reports sales of business property, depreciation recapture and certain involuntary conversions.

forms.title: General Business Credit
forms.one_liner: Combines the separate business credits and applies the overall limit on them.

forms.title: Credit for Increasing Research Activities
forms.one_liner: Claims the research credit and makes related elections such as the payroll tax offset.

forms.title: S Corporation Shareholder Stock and Debt Basis Limitations
forms.one_liner: Lets an S corporation shareholder figure stock and debt basis to see how much loss they can deduct.

forms.title: Rental Real Estate Income and Expenses of a Partnership or an S Corporation
forms.one_liner: Reports rental real estate income and expenses of a partnership or S corporation.

forms.title: Limitation on Business Interest Expense Under Section 163(j)
forms.one_liner: Figures how much business interest expense can be deducted this year and what carries forward.

forms.title: Application for Employer Identification Number (EIN)
forms.one_liner: Applies for an employer identification number for a business, trust, estate or other entity.

forms.title: Election by a Small Business Corporation
forms.one_liner: Elects S corporation status for an eligible corporation or LLC.

forms.title: Entity Classification Election
forms.one_liner: Lets an eligible entity, such as an LLC, choose how it is classified for federal tax purposes.

forms.title: Corporate Dissolution or Liquidation
forms.one_liner: Notifies the IRS that a corporation has adopted a plan to dissolve or liquidate.

forms.title: Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Quarterly report of wages paid and income, Social Security and Medicare taxes withheld and owed.

forms.title: Adjusted Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return or Claim for Refund
forms.one_liner: Corrects errors on a Form 941 that was already filed.

forms.title: Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Annual report of federal unemployment tax owed by an employer.

forms.title: Employer's Annual Federal Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Annual employment tax return for small employers the IRS has told to file it instead of Form 941.

forms.title: Employer's Annual Federal Tax Return for Agricultural Employees
forms.one_liner: Annual employment tax return for wages paid to farmworkers.

forms.title: Wage and Tax Statement
forms.one_liner: Reports an employee's annual wages and taxes withheld; given to the employee and filed with SSA.

forms.title: Transmittal of Wage and Tax Statements
forms.one_liner: Summary that accompanies paper Forms W-2 sent to the Social Security Administration.

forms.title: Employee's Withholding Certificate
forms.one_liner: Completed by an employee so the employer withholds the right amount of federal income tax.

forms.title: Withholding Certificate for Periodic Pension or Annuity Payments
forms.one_liner: Tells a pension or annuity payer how much federal income tax to withhold from periodic payments.

forms.title: Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification
forms.one_liner: Collects a payee's name and taxpayer identification number so the payer can file information returns.

forms.title: Certificate of Foreign Status of Beneficial Owner for United States Tax Withholding and Reporting (Individuals)
forms.one_liner: Certifies that an individual is a foreign person, and claims any treaty benefits, for withholding purposes.

forms.title: Annual Summary and Transmittal of U.S. Information Returns
forms.one_liner: Cover summary for paper information returns (such as Forms 1099) sent to the IRS.

forms.title: Nonemployee Compensation
forms.one_liner: Reports payments to independent contractors and other nonemployees.

forms.title: Miscellaneous Information
forms.one_liner: Reports rents, royalties, prizes, attorney proceeds and other miscellaneous payments.

forms.title: Interest Income
forms.one_liner: Reports interest paid to a taxpayer.

forms.title: Dividends and Distributions
forms.one_liner: Reports dividends and capital gain distributions paid to a taxpayer.

forms.title: Proceeds From Broker and Barter Exchange Transactions
forms.one_liner: Reports proceeds (and often basis) from sales of stocks, bonds and other securities through a broker.

forms.title: Distributions From Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc.
forms.one_liner: Reports distributions from retirement plans, IRAs and annuities.

forms.title: Payment Card and Third Party Network Transactions
forms.one_liner: Reports payments received through card processors and payment apps or online marketplaces.

forms.title: Proceeds From Real Estate Transactions
forms.one_liner: Reports gross proceeds from the sale of real estate.

forms.title: Certain Government Payments
forms.one_liner: Reports unemployment compensation, state tax refunds and other government payments.

forms.title: Mortgage Interest Statement
forms.one_liner: Reports mortgage interest of $600 or more received from a borrower.

forms.title: Return of Organization Exempt From Income Tax
forms.one_liner: The annual information return for most tax-exempt organizations.

forms.title: Short Form Return of Organization Exempt From Income Tax
forms.one_liner: A shorter annual return for smaller exempt organizations that qualify.

forms.title: Return of Private Foundation
forms.one_liner: The annual return for private foundations.

forms.title: Exempt Organization Business Income Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Reports unrelated business income of an exempt organization and the tax on it.

forms.title: U.S. Income Tax Return for Estates and Trusts
forms.one_liner: The annual income tax return for estates and trusts.

forms.title: United States Estate (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Reports a decedent's estate and computes any estate and generation-skipping transfer tax.

forms.title: United States Gift (and Generation-Skipping Transfer) Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Reports gifts above the annual exclusion and any gift or generation-skipping transfer tax.

forms.title: Notice Concerning Fiduciary Relationship
forms.one_liner: Tells the IRS that a person is acting as a fiduciary, such as an executor or trustee.

forms.title: Power of Attorney and Declaration of Representative
forms.one_liner: Authorizes an attorney, CPA or enrolled agent to represent a taxpayer before the IRS.

forms.title: Tax Information Authorization
forms.one_liner: Lets a named person receive a taxpayer's confidential tax information without representing them.

forms.title: Request for Transcript of Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Requests IRS transcripts of past returns and account information.

forms.title: IVES Request for Transcript of Tax Return
forms.one_liner: Lets an authorized third party, such as a lender, request a taxpayer's transcripts with consent.

forms.title: Change of Address
forms.one_liner: Notifies the IRS of a change of home address for individual returns.

forms.title: Change of Address or Responsible Party—Business
forms.one_liner: Notifies the IRS of a business's new mailing address, location or responsible party.

forms.title: IRS e-file Signature Authorization
forms.one_liner: Lets a taxpayer authorize the preparer to e-file their return with a self-selected PIN.

forms.title: Paid Preparer's Due Diligence Checklist
forms.one_liner: Preparer's due diligence checklist for returns claiming EIC, CTC/ODC, AOTC or head of household status.

forms.title: Installment Agreement Request
forms.one_liner: Requests a monthly payment plan for tax that cannot be paid in full.

forms.title: Offer in Compromise (Form 656 Booklet)
forms.one_liner: Booklet with Form 656 for offering to settle a tax debt for less than the full amount owed.

forms.title: Collection Information Statement for Wage Earners and Self-Employed Individuals
forms.one_liner: Detailed financial statement an individual gives the IRS when resolving a balance due.

forms.title: Collection Information Statement
forms.one_liner: Shorter financial statement used for many installment agreements and collection cases.

forms.title: Request for Innocent Spouse Relief
forms.one_liner: Requests relief from tax owed on a joint return that should be paid by a spouse or former spouse.

forms.title: Claim for Refund and Request for Abatement
forms.one_liner: Asks the IRS to refund or remove certain taxes, penalties, fees and interest.

forms.title: Request for a Collection Due Process or Equivalent Hearing
forms.one_liner: Requests an Independent Office of Appeals hearing after a lien or levy notice.

forms.title: Request for Taxpayer Advocate Service Assistance
forms.one_liner: Asks the Taxpayer Advocate Service for help with an IRS problem causing hardship or unresolved through normal channels.
